title: Design System: ContentOps X native pilot

button.purpose: Native action labels with inherited font size.

components.name: One-time publication button
components.description: Source-derived primary action; shown disabled by default, without executable behavior.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:44px; padding:11px 16px; border:1px solid #333697; border-radius:8px; color:#fff; background:#333697; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:inherit; line-height:1.4; cursor:pointer; margin-top:16px; text-align:left; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#252874; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.6; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #333697; outline-offset:3px; } @media(max-width:420px) { .ds-primary { width:100%; } }

components.name: No-send secondary button
components.description: Shared secondary treatment for identity, no-send check, readiness and reconciliation.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height:44px; padding:11px 16px; border:1px solid #333697; border-radius:8px; color:#333697; background:#fff; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:inherit; line-height:1.4; cursor:pointer; margin-top:16px; text-align:left; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#ededfa; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.6; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #333697; outline-offset:3px; } @media(max-width:420px) { .ds-secondary { width:100%; } }

components.name: Public package field
components.description: Visible label, resizable textarea and linked public-data warning.
components.html: Не вставляйте сюда токены или cookies.
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; color:#252536; } .ds-field { display:block; width:100%; padding:12px; border:1px solid #9292ab; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#252536; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:inherit; caret-color:#333697; resize:vertical; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #333697; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-help { color:#4b4b60; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.55; margin:12px 0 0; max-width:70ch; }

components.name: Exact-package consent
components.description: Native checkbox with deliberate consent; unavailable in the initial state.
components.html: <label class="ds-consent"><input class="ds-checkbox" type="checkbox" disabled>Опубликовать именно этот пакет в указанном аккаунте</label>
components.css: .ds-consent { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:400; color:#252536; line-height:1.5; padding:8px 0; margin-top:20px; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-checkbox { width:20px; height:20px; flex:0 0 20px; margin:0; accent-color:#333697; } .ds-checkbox:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #333697; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Persistent status
components.description: Polite live text; neutral presentation does not claim publication success.
components.html: Проверка ещё не выполнялась.
components.css: .ds-status { color:#4b4b60; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.55; max-width:70ch; white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; padding:16px; margin:28px 0 0; background:#ededf6; }

components.name: Public installation disclosure
components.description: Native collapsed disclosure; public identity is separate from enrollment and permission.
components.html:
Данные установки для подключения

Только публичный ключ и ID. Они не дают разрешения на публикацию.
components.css: .ds-details { margin-top:16px; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; color:#252536; } .ds-summary { cursor:pointer; padding:12px 0; } .ds-summary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #333697; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-disclosure-help { color:#4b4b60; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.55; margin:12px 0 0; max-width:70ch; }

narrative.overview:
This document captures the existing X native pilot, not a new brand direction. The first body comment in `pilot.html` is the visual authority: retain ContentOps restrained indigo, flat sections and native form controls. Arial, a light canvas and sparse indigo actions support a precise operator workflow.

The package and no-send check precede an explicitly separate publication area. Installation identity, signed backend pairing/enrollment, backend owner UAT, no-send checking and released publication are separate events. The popup does not grant those authorities. Future publications reuse the installation enrollment through the shared lifecycle; the popup no-send action is not a requirement to repeat backend enrollment or owner UAT for each post.

Verification: the initial **No usable sandbox** result is superseded by a successful bounded fixture run in the existing reviewed container sandbox, using its exact seccomp profile and `SYS_CHROOT`, not `SYS_ADMIN`. `chrome://sandbox` reported namespace and seccomp protections **YES**. Desktop (`720px`) and mobile (`360px`) screenshots are recorded at the repository-relative paths `.impeccable/review/desktop.png` and `.impeccable/review/mobile.png`. The `x_finish_review` inspection returned **PASS — bounded visual/source review**. Both scoped P2 source fixes are resolved; the P1 claim that each popup check must repeat backend owner UAT is withdrawn. Real-account owner UAT remains unperformed; fixture evidence does not establish live publication readiness or owner acceptance.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained inherited indigo; no replacement palette or visual world.
Flat, rule-separated sections with native controls and visible labels.
Textual status, explicit consent and a disabled-by-default send action.
Public installation information only; no secret-bearing presentation.

rules.name: The Textual State Rule
rules.body: Do not invent success/error colors: the current implementation distinguishes outcomes in the status text, not by a semantic color ramp.

rules.name: The Authority Separation Rule
rules.body: Preserve the visual and textual separation between installation identity, no-send checking, readiness, deliberate publication and reconciliation. Local intent never replaces server authorization.

dos: Do preserve the inherited indigo, Arial and flat section rhythm.
Do keep no-send checking and publication visibly separate.
Do retain labels, keyboard focus outlines, native disclosures and textual status.
Do preserve expired, busy, disabled and uncertain states as distinct operator outcomes.
Do keep enrollment/backend owner UAT separate from popup no-send checks and reuse enrollment for future publications.
donts: Don't invent a new palette, tonal ramp, card system, navigation or decorative imagery.
Don't imply installation data, pairing, readiness or a receipt proves publication success.
Don't bypass consent, exact-package authorization or same-attempt reconciliation with a visual shortcut.
Don't present fixture screenshots, source inspection or this document as real-account owner acceptance.
